name: com.sauti.voice-ai
description: Native Unity voice-AI plugin. Fully offline. English. Privacy-first. Mic → Whisper → memory + RAG → Qwen3 GGUF → Kokoro → audio. Two strictly-partitioned runtimes (ONNX Runtime + llama.cpp) on a managed C# façade with three-layer memory (conversation history + temporary KV + RAG over a knowledge base you author).

_peerDependencies_documentation_only._comment: UPM doesn't allow Git URL values inside a package's 'dependencies' (semver only). These two MUST be added to the consumer's Packages/manifest.json — Sauti's Setup Wizard does that automatically via 'Sauti → Verify Setup → Fix everything I can'.

samples.description: Type a string in the Inspector, hear it spoken via Kokoro 82M ONNX. Validates the TTS stack independently.
Hold a button, speak, release. Whisper Small/Tiny transcribes to on-screen text.
Text input → Qwen3-1.7B → streamed tokens + sentence-boundary UnityEvent for downstream TTS.
Same question with-RAG vs without-RAG, side by side. Proves retrieval changes the answer.
Mic → STT → memory + RAG → LLM → on-screen text (Kokoro TTS via OnSpeechReady hook). The headline demo.
Quest controller trigger drives the full loop with Kokoro synthesising into a spatial AudioSource on an NPC GameObject.
7 sample knowledge-base entries (lore + locations + NPCs). Copy under your own knowledge-base/ then run `Sauti → Build Knowledge Base`.
